question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is 528 m² and its volume is 1848 m³. Find the total surface area (in m²) of the cylinder. ({Take } pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Curved surface area = 528

Volume = 1848

 pi = (22)/(7) 

**Formula Used:**

CSA = 2πrh

Volume = πr²h

TSA = 2πr(h + r)

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r × h = 528

⇒ (44/7)rh = 528

⇒ rh = 528 × 7 ÷ 44

⇒ rh = 84

⇒ πr²h = 1848

⇒ (22/7) × r² × h = 1848

⇒ r × (rh) = 1848 × 7 ÷ 22

⇒ r × 84 = 588

⇒ r = 588 ÷ 84 = 7

⇒ h = 84 ÷ 7 = 12

⇒ TSA = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × (12 + 7)

⇒ TSA = 44 × 19

⇒ TSA = 836

**∴ The correct answer is 836.**
